params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: Three key figures of a deck on young people and self-employment should be held in Gentells at their original source, so the full report can cite them with a source a reader can check. Today a statistic can only be recorded under a sentence of a live post.

Source: Portal mail:51.

## What is asked

Record the key figures themselves, the way the figures in the posts about money are held at their origin:

- 9,155 student-self-employed
- 55% from the TUI youth study
- the fall from 40.3% to 31.8% at Securex

## The figures at their origin (opened and read 2026-11-15)

| Figure | What it measures | Publisher, publication, place |
|---|---|---|
| 9,155 | student-self-employed in Belgium on 31 December 2025 (8,716 a year earlier, +5.04%) | RSVZ, "Cijfers en tendensen 2025", section "Aantal student-zelfstandigen op 31 december 2025"; `rsvz.be/sites/rsvz/files/2026-05/Cijfers_en_tendensen_2025.pdf` |
| 55% | young Europeans who can imagine becoming self-employed or founding a company; ages 16 to 26, 8,024 asked online in DE, UK, FR, ES, IT, GR, PL, 2026 | TUI Stiftung, "Junges Europa 2026", full report p. 78; `tui-stiftung.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2026_Gesamtbericht-TUI-Stiftung-Jugendstudie.pdf` |
| 40.3% to 31.8% | share of employees under 30 in all new open-ended contracts, 2024 against 2025 (a relative fall of 21.3%) | Securex, press release of 5 February 2026 on the cooling labour market; `press.securex.be/afkoelende-arbeidsmarkt-treft-jongste-werknemers-het-hardst-minder-onbepaalde-duurcontracten-meer-ontslagen` |

Note on the third: it is about open-ended contracts for employees, not about self-employment. A sentence that uses it should say so.

## What stands in the way, and what the pull request does

`bin/cite-statistics.mjs` wrote a statistic only under a sentence of a published post, and no read returned statistics to an agent. A report or a deck that is still being written has no post, so its figures came from the open web.

The pull request for this issue:

1. lets a plan entry without an article record the statistic and its publisher, under the same checks of the Standard and with the same undo;
2. adds a `statistics` read on the agent door: every figure as a reader reads it, with publisher, publication, place, address and whether it may be cited;
3. holds the three figures as two plans. `research/statistics-2026-11-15.json` has the RSVZ figure, whose terms were read (reuse under CC0). `research/statistics-2026-11-15-terms-open.json` has the TUI Stiftung and Securex figures with the terms left empty: the TUI Stiftung site reserves all rights and forbids commercial copying, and the Securex press room states no terms. A person reads or asks, fills in the terms, and runs the plan.

## Left after the merge

- On the box: run the first plan with `--admitted-by`; decide on the terms of the other two.
- A member's own assistant reads Gentells through the MCP server of gentells.com, which does not know statistics yet. That is a separate issue in the site repository.
params.title: Record key figures at their origin without a post to hang them on
